name: usql
description: Universal command-line interface for SQL databases supporting 30+ database types

usql.description: Universal SQL client supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Oracle, SQL Server and many others
usql.usage:
usql postgres://user:pass@host/db
usql mysql://user:pass@host/db
usql sqlite:database.db
usql 'SELECT * FROM users;'
usql --drivers
